---
title: "FPGA Design"
description: "Planned position PI, PWM, and shutdown on the UPduino."
---

## Revised Responsibilities

The UPduino will receive estimated gap, requested gap, measured current, and status from the MCU. It will run **position PI at 1 kHz** using DSP blocks and generate **20 kHz PWM**. PI output is PWM duty directly. The MCU owns ADC acquisition and gap estimation.

Current supports compensation, telemetry, and protection; it has no separate feedback controller in this plan. See the [position-control equation](design.qmd#gap-and-position-control).

## Timing and Gain Updates

A nominal 24 MHz clock divided by 1200 produces 20 kHz PWM. Position control updates once per millisecond. Gain changes must be range-checked and applied together at a control boundary. Fixed-point scaling, arithmetic widths, saturation, integrator anti-windup, and the revised SPI contract still need implementation and tests.

## Shutdown

The proposal calls for drive removal after 50 ms without valid MCU commands, an MCU drive-permit signal, and independent E-stop/overcurrent-comparator disabling of the driver. Measure gate-disable delay and current decay separately. The 50 ms figure is a proposed command timeout, not a measured physical stopping time.

## Existing HDL and Evidence

[lev_core.sv](fpga/rtl/lev_core.sv), [current_pi.sv](fpga/rtl/current_pi.sv), and [spi_frame.sv](fpga/rtl/spi_frame.sv) belong to the earlier current-controller implementation. The [October 26 verification](docs/verification.qmd) reports its enabled build at 1099/5280 logic cells, 2/8 DSP blocks, and a 46.59 MHz routed clock estimate. These figures do not describe the proposed position controller.

The standalone [SPI sender](simple_byte/spi_byte.sv) and [testbench](simple_byte/tb_spi_byte.sv) exercise a byte read without the levitation application. Recorded checks cover all 256 byte values, deselection, and partial-transfer restart. See [Results](results.qmd).
